content:
extends Control
class_name TouchCameraSurface

signal camera_drag(delta: Vector2)

var pointer_id := -1
var last_position := Vector2.ZERO

func _ready() -> void:
    mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP

func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
    if event is InputEventScreenTouch:
        var touch := event as InputEventScreenTouch
        if touch.pressed and pointer_id < 0:
            pointer_id = touch.index
            last_position = touch.position
            accept_event()
        elif not touch.pressed and touch.index == pointer_id:
            pointer_id = -1
            accept_event()

    elif event is InputEventScreenDrag:
        var drag := event as InputEventScreenDrag
        if drag.index == pointer_id:
            var delta := drag.position - last_position
            last_position = drag.position
            camera_drag.emit(delta)
            accept_event()
